html:
tokentrim pro benefits

You can upgrade to tokentrim Pro to get a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, and weekly budget alerts. The Pro subscription costs $49 once for the first 500 buyers or $9/month.

How it works

tokentrim Pro adds a hosted dashboard that you can access on any device, showing your token usage and budget. You also get a Monday digest and a weekly budget alert when you hit 80% of your limit. The Pro features work with the local hooks and replay command that you get with the free toolkit.

What you get and what it costs

The free features include all hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold-cache alert. The Pro subscription adds a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, and weekly budget alert at 80%. You can buy the Pro subscription for $49 once or $9/month.

FAQ

What is the difference between the free and Pro plans? The free plan gives you all local hooks and a basic dashboard. Pro adds a hosted dashboard and weekly alerts. Can I try Pro before buying? You can install the free toolkit and then upgrade to Pro with a one-time $49 payment or a $9/month subscription. Do I need a paid plan to see my token usage? No. The free dashboard shows daily usage and budget guard. Pro only expands the dashboard and adds alerts.

To get started with tokentrim Pro, install the free toolkit and then upgrade to Pro.
